title: Agentic Evolution of SQL Test Generators
title_zh: SQL测试生成器的智能体演化

paragraphs.en: Automated testing has uncovered many logic bugs in Database Management Systems (DBMSs). Existing tools are typically limited to a few SQL dialects and a subset of these dialects’ features. Coding agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs) could encode the semantics of additional SQL features, which would then require no additional LLM calls during these tools’ run time, thus allowing high efficiency and low cost. However, a key challenge is to ensure the correctness of the added features in the presence of potential hallucinations. In this paper, we propose Gungnir , an approach for evolving DBMS test generators using coding agents. We use witness replay to validate generator modifications by replaying the choices needed to generate a target statement. A generation witness is responsible for recording the database setup and semantic choices needed to generate the target statement. A validator checks the witness by replaying these choices through the generator and checking that it reproduces the target statement. We tested Gungnir on SQLite, DuckDB, and PostgreSQL and found 44 bugs confirmed by developers, of which 34 have been fixed. Beyond DBMSs, witness replay could generalize to other systems for guiding agents in extending test generators.

paragraphs.en: Database Management Systems (DBMSs) are complex software systems whose correctness affects downstream applications. Besides crashes and performance issues, DBMSs can contain logic bugs , which cause queries to return incorrect results without raising an error. Automated testing approaches detect these bugs by generating SQL statements and checking their results with a test oracle ( Rigger and Su, 2020b ; Rigger and Su, 2020a ) . These approaches have uncovered hundreds of previously unknown bugs in widely used DBMSs ( Zhong and Rigger, 2026b ; Zhong and Rigger, 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 数据库管理系统（DBMS）是复杂的软件系统，其正确性会影响下游应用程序。 除了崩溃和性能问题外，DBMS 还可能包含逻辑错误，这些错误会导致查询返回不正确结果而不会抛出错误。 自动化测试方法通过生成 SQL 语句并用测试预言机验证其结果来检测这些错误（Rigger and Su, 2020b; Rigger and Su, 2020a）。 这些方法已发现广泛使用的 DBMS 中数百个此前未知的错误（Zhong and Rigger, 2026b; Zhong and Rigger, 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: The effectiveness of a test oracle depends on which SQL features the generated statements contain. Mutation-based tools derive inputs from existing statements, and their scope depends on the seed corpus and available mutation operators ( Zhong et al., 2020 ) . Generation-based tools create schemas, populate tables, and generate queries from predefined rules ( Rigger and Su, 2020a ; Rigger and Su, 2020b ; Rigger and Su, 2020c ) . Once implemented, a generator can repeatedly test its supported features at high throughput. The challenge of supporting the multitude of SQL features within a generator is further exacerbated given that most DBMSs implement a distinct SQL dialect. SQLancer++ supports an adaptive generator that adjusts generation probabilities during run-time to fit different dialects, but requires manual source modifications to support new SQL features ( Zhong and Rigger, 2026b ) . Listing 1 shows a reduced test case that exposes a logic bug in SQLite, which SQLancer++ fails to find due to lack of support for row value IN predicates with aggregate subqueries. The existing test oracle can detect this bug once the generator supports the required predicate. Automating this task would allow the generator to incorporate new SQL features as DBMSs evolve. However, adding such support requires understanding both the generator implementation and the SQL features of the target DBMS.

paragraphs.en: Recent work uses Large Language Models (LLMs) within predefined workflows to automatically improve DBMS testing tools. For example, ShQveL uses LLMs to add validated SQL fragments to the generator, while Argus uses LLMs to propose test oracles that are independently verified ( Zhong and Rigger, 2026a ; Mang et al., 2026b ) . However, the SQL features supported by these workflows depend on their generation and verification mechanisms. ShQveL fills predefined sketches, while Argus verifies query relations within the SQL features supported by its underlying solver and base generator. Both generators lack support for generating the row value IN comparison with a subquery to trigger the bug in Listing 1 . Extending these mechanisms to support additional SQL features still requires modifications to the test generator.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究在预定义的工作流中使用了大型语言模型（LLM），以自动改进数据库管理系统（DBMS）的测试工具。 例如，ShQveL 使用 LLM 向生成器添加经过验证的 SQL 片段，而 Argus 则使用 LLM 提出测试预言子，这些预言子会经过独立验证（Zhong and Rigger, 2026a；Mang et al., 2026b）。 然而，这些工作流所支持的 SQL 特性取决于其生成和验证机制。 ShQveL 填充预定义的模板，而 Argus 则在其底层求解器和基础生成器所支持的 SQL 特性范围内验证查询关系。 这两种生成器都无法支持生成行值与子查询的 IN 比较操作，而这种操作正是触发列表 1 中错误的关键。 要将这些机制扩展以支持更多的 SQL 特性，仍然需要修改测试生成器。

paragraphs.en: Increasing LLM capability opens new opportunities for greater autonomy than in previous work ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . Coding agents can inspect software repositories and implement modifications across several source files ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . These agents could implement the state handling and generation rules needed for a new SQL feature. However, a key challenge is to deterministically validate whether the modified generator can generate statements containing the requested feature. Current feedback signals provide insufficient evidence for the agents to determine when a certain feature can be generated. First, checking for a successful build provides insufficient evidence that the generator can generate requested features during run-time. Second, it is difficult to validate whether the generator can generate a requested feature, since, due to the inherent stochasticity of generators, the feature would not necessarily be generated within a fixed timeframe. Third, coverage feedback can guide LLM-driven generator evolution ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , but an increase in coverage does not show that a requested statement can be generated.
paragraphs.zh: 提升大型语言模型的能力为智能体带来了比以往研究更大的自主性机会（Luo 等人，2026）。 编码智能体能够检查软件仓库，并在多个源文件中实施修改（Yang 等人，2024；Zhang 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2025）。 这些智能体可以实施新 SQL 功能所需的狀態處理和生成規則。 然而，一个关键挑战是确定性地验证修改后的生成器是否能够生成包含所需功能的语句。 当前的反馈信号无法为智能体提供足够的证据，以判断某个特定功能何时能够被生成。 首先，检查构建是否成功并不能充分证明生成器能够在运行时生成所需的功能。 其次，很难验证生成器是否能够生成所需的功能，因为由于生成器固有的随机性，该功能未必会在固定的时间范围内被生成。 第三，覆盖度反馈可以指导由大型语言模型驱动的生成器演化（Chen 等人，2025），但覆盖度的增加并不能表明所需语句能够被生成。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose Gungnir , a system for evolving DBMS test generators with coding agents. Our core insight is to require the coding agent to provide a so-called generation witness alongside each generator modification, providing concrete evidence of how the modified generator can generate a target statement. We realize this witness mechanism through a common guidance interface that records the semantic choices instrumented in the generator. The input to the witness mechanism is a target SQL statement—which can contain one or more new SQL features. A generation witness records the database setup and semantic choices needed to generate this target. The coding agent is responsible for implementing the requested feature and identifying the choices needed to generate the target; the validator is responsible for checking this evidence by replaying the choices through the modified generator, comparing the complete generated statement with the target statement, and running the required executable check before the modification can be accepted for further testing. For subsequent modifications, we require the coding agent to preserve previously witnessed behavior, which the validator checks by replaying the historical witnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 Gungnir——一个利用编码智能体演化 DBMS 测试生成器的系统。 我们的核心思路是要求编码智能体在每次修改生成器时，提供一个所谓的“生成见证”，以具体证明修改后的生成器如何能够生成目标语句。 我们通过一个通用的引导接口来实现这种见证机制，该接口会记录生成器中实现的语义选择。 见证机制的输入是一个目标 SQL 语句——其中可能包含一个或多个新的 SQL 特性。 生成见证记录了生成该目标语句所需的数据库配置和语义选择。 编码智能体负责实现所请求的特性，并确定生成目标语句所需的选择；验证器则负责通过重新执行这些选择于修改后的生成器中、将完整生成的语句与目标语句进行比较，并在修改被接受用于进一步测试前运行必要的可执行检查，来验证这些证据。 对于后续的修改，我们要求编码智能体保留之前已见证的行为，而验证器则通过重新执行历史见证来对此进行检查。

paragraphs.en: We implement Gungnir as a multi-agent system (MAS) that evolves SQLancer++, separating the analysis of missing DBMS features from their integration into the test generator. An analyst agent derives target statements from DBMS source code, tests, and bug reports, while a coding agent modifies the generator using witness feedback. A triage agent investigates failures found during DBMS testing. The testing results and triage findings guide the analyst agent’s selection of further targets, forming a controlled evolution loop. After evolution, no more calls to the LLM or witness mechanism are required.

paragraphs.en: We evaluated Gungnir on SQLite, DuckDB, and PostgreSQL and reported 44 bugs confirmed by developers, of which 34 have been fixed. The evolved generators achieved higher line and branch coverage than the generator baselines on all three DBMSs in the reported runs. paragraphs.en: We propose witness replay , which checks whether a modified generator can generate target statements and supplies feedback for further source modifications.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“见证重演”方法，该方法用于检查修改后的生成器是否能够生成目标陈述，并为进一步的源文本修改提供反馈。

paragraphs.en: We implement Gungnir , a system that evolves SQLancer++ with coding agents and preserves the resulting features for DBMS testing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们实现了 Gungnir——一个通过编码智能体演化 SQLancer++ 的系统，并保留其生成的特征以用于 DBMS 测试。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Gungnir on SQLite, DuckDB, and PostgreSQL, reporting 44 bugs confirmed by developers, including 34 fixed bugs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SQLite、DuckDB 和 PostgreSQL 上对 Gungnir 进行了评估，报告了 44 个经开发者确认的漏洞，其中包括 34 个已修复的漏洞。

paragraphs.en: We first introduce SQL generators and test oracles, then discuss how LLMs can help generate SQL test cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先介绍 SQL 生成器和测试预言机，然后讨论 LLM 如何帮助生成 SQL 测试用例。

paragraphs.en: SQL generators construct test cases from scratch based on predefined rules ( Rigger and Su, 2020c ; Rigger and Su, 2020b ; Zhong and Rigger, 2026b ) . The rules define how to create a database schema, populate tables, and generate queries following target DBMS semantics. First, generators track the database state to satisfy dependencies among statements. For example, a table must exist before an insertion, and a query can reference only columns available in the current schema. Second, the generator needs to generate statements that are syntactically and semantically valid for the target DBMS. For example, it selects columns and operations with compatible types when constructing expressions. SQL dialects add further constraints on which features a DBMS accepts ( Zhong and Rigger, 2024 ; Zhong and Rigger, 2026b ) . For example, SQLancer supports 22 DBMS-specific generators with an average of 3.1K lines of code (LOC) for generation and supporting components. Supporting a new feature requires modifications to schema handling, expression generation, and SQL rendering. Third, the generator needs to satisfy the test oracle’s syntactic and semantic constraints. These requirements extend to generators that are modified by an LLM, such as in our work.
paragraphs.zh: SQL 生成器根据预定义规则从头构建测试用例（Rigger 和 Su，2020c；Rigger 和 Su，2020b；Zhong 和 Rigger，2026b）。 这些规则定义了如何创建数据库模式、填充表以及按照目标 DBMS 的语义生成查询。 首先，生成器需要跟踪数据库状态，以满足各语句之间的依赖关系。 例如，在执行插入操作之前必须存在相应的表，且查询只能引用当前模式中可用的列。 其次，生成器需要为目标 DBMS 生成语法和语义上都有效的语句。 例如，在构建表达式时，它会选择类型兼容的列和操作。 SQL 方言对 DBMS 可接受的功能附加了更多限制（Zhong 和 Rigger，2024；Zhong 和 Rigger，2026b）。 例如，SQLancer 支持 22 种特定的 DBMS 生成器，其生成代码及支持组件的平均代码行数为 3.1K 行（LOC）。 要支持新功能，必须对模式处理、表达式生成和 SQL 渲染进行修改。 第三，生成器需要满足测试预言机的语法和语义约束。 这些要求同样适用于通过 LLM 修改的生成器，例如我们研究中的情况。

paragraphs.en: A test oracle determines the expected result of a test case. It allows the testing tool to check whether a randomly generated SQL statement returns the expected result. Ternary Logic Partitioning (TLP) is a widely used oracle for logic bug detection ( Rigger and Su, 2020b ) . TLP divides the rows of one query according to whether a random predicate evaluates to true, false, or NULL, then compares the union of these partitions with the original result. While Gungnir relies on TLP in its implementation, it can adapt any of the existing test oracles. We deliberately avoid using LLMs for generating test oracles, since an incorrect one—for example, caused by hallucinations—would result in false alarms that would require developer intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 测试预言机用于确定测试用例的预期结果。 它使测试工具能够检查随机生成的 SQL 语句是否返回预期结果。 三值逻辑分区（TLP）是一种广泛用于检测逻辑错误的预言机（Rigger 和 Su，2020b）。 TLP 根据随机谓词的结果是否为真、假或 NULL 对查询的行进行划分，然后将这些分区的并集与原始结果进行比较。 尽管 Gungnir 在其实现中依赖 TLP，但它能够适配任何现有的测试预言机。 我们刻意避免使用 LLM 生成测试预言机，因为错误的预言机——例如由幻觉导致的错误——会产生误报，从而需要开发人员介入处理。

paragraphs.en: A plausible way to automate DBMS testing is to let coding agents directly generate SQL test cases and execute them to then investigate potential bugs, potentially also allowing them to inspect the DBMS’ source code. However, this direct approach faces three challenges. First, the agent can infer an incorrect expected result and report correct behavior as a logic bug. This difficulty also occurs in general software testing: RepoAudit reports false positives in code auditing ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , and agentic property-based testing documents agents mistaking intended behavior for bugs ( Maaz et al., 2025 ) . Second, generating test cases requires many LLM calls unless the generation logic is saved for reuse, adding inference cost and latency to continued testing. Third, the search space of agents can be biased toward familiar bug patterns learned during pretraining, such as incorrect handling of boundary values. These patterns can guide useful bug findings, but may also concentrate testing on similar cases and leave unfamiliar feature combinations unexplored. These difficulties motivate using agents to extend a reusable SQL generator.
paragraphs.zh: 一种可行的 DBMS 测试自动化方法是让编码智能体直接生成 SQL 测试用例并执行，进而排查潜在错误，甚至可能允许它们检查 DBMS 的源代码。 然而，这种直接方法面临三个挑战。 首先，智能体可能会推断出错误的预期结果，并将正确的行为误报为逻辑错误。 这一难题也存在于通用软件测试中：RepoAudit 在代码审计中报告了假阳性（Guo et al., 2025），而基于属性的智能体测试则记录了智能体将预期行为误认为错误的情况（Maaz et al., 2025）。 其次，除非将生成逻辑保存下来重复使用，否则生成测试用例需要大量 LLM 调用，这会为持续测试增加推理成本和延迟。 第三，智能体的搜索空间可能会偏向于预训练期间学到的熟悉错误模式，例如对边界值的处理不当。 这些模式虽然能引导发现有用的错误，但也可能导致测试集中在类似案例上，而忽略不熟悉的功能组合。 这些困难促使人们利用智能体来扩展一个可重用的 SQL 生成器。

paragraphs.en: Retaining validated LLM knowledge in a generator allows repeated testing without further model calls and avoids the false alarms that arise from relying on LLMs to judge correctness. ShQveL fills SQL sketches with LLMs and saves validated fragments for subsequent test generation ( Zhong and Rigger, 2026a ) . It checks filled sketches by execution and uses existing test oracles to detect logic bugs. Argus discovers pairs of abstract queries, verifies their equivalence with a SQL equivalence solver, and instantiates them with reusable SQL snippets ( Mang et al., 2026b ) . Its soundness depends on the verified equivalence and the constraints imposed on snippet instantiation. Both approaches validate LLM outputs before using them for testing instead of relying on the LLM to judge correctness.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose Gungnir , which tackles the problem of reliably building and continually improving automated DBMS testing tools for finding logic bugs. The core mechanism of Gungnir is witness replay , which checks whether a modified generator can generate a requested SQL statement. We assign a coding agent the responsibility of modifying the generator to support given target SQL statements—which provide concrete examples of feature usage—and providing executable evidence of that support. A generation witness records the database setup and semantic choices needed to generate a target statement. An external validator checks whether the agent has fulfilled this responsibility by replaying each witness through the modified generator, comparing the generated statement with its target. Failures guide further modifications to the generator and its witness, and the witnesses are saved for regression testing of future generator modifications. Figure 1 illustrates these steps for a row value IN predicate whose right side is an aggregate subquery. We next detail these steps.

paragraphs.en: Replay failures provide feedback to the coding agent for modifying the generator and its witness assignments. Witness validation can fail in three ways. First, an assigned value can be unavailable: A ⁡ ( d i ) ∉ D G ′ ​ ( d i , x i ) A(d_{i})\notin D_{G^{\prime}}(d_{i},x_{i}) at a visited decision. Third, the generated statement can differ from the target statement ( Q ′ ≠ Q Q^{\prime}\neq Q ), or historical replay can fail to reproduce the recorded SQL. paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows how Gungnir coordinates the analyst and coding agents with the evolved testing tool. The analyst agent specifies capability goals containing target queries, and the coding agent modifies the generator and constructs generation witnesses to complete the goals. This separation is motivated by studies of LLM-based testing showing that tests generated from incorrect code can repeat the implementation’s incorrect assumptions ( Konstantinou et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . This separation also allows the agents to work in parallel. For example, while the analyst examines the target DBMS’s source code, the coding agent can extend the generator using previously prepared goals. The validator independently replays these witnesses against target queries and returns failures as feedback to the coding agent. The orchestrator determines goal completion from the validation results and directs further testing with the accepted generator. Testing results guide subsequent analysis, forming a feedback loop.
paragraphs.zh: 图2展示了Gungnir如何协调分析师智能体、编码智能体与演化测试工具之间的协作。 分析师智能体指定包含目标查询的能力目标，而编码智能体则修改生成器并构建生成见证以完成这些目标。 这种分离的动机源于对基于LLM的测试的研究，研究表明，由错误代码生成的测试可能会重复实现中的错误假设（Konstantinou等，2026；Zhao等，2026）。 这种分离也允许各智能体并行工作。 例如，在分析师检查目标DBMS源代码的同时，编码智能体可以利用预先准备好的目标来扩展生成器。 验证器独立地针对目标查询重演这些见证，并将失败结果作为反馈返回给编码智能体。 协调器根据验证结果判断目标是否完成，并指导使用已通过的生成器进行后续测试。 测试结果引导后续分析，从而形成一个反馈循环。

paragraphs.en: A capability goal describes a SQL feature to be added using different variants of concrete target statements containing that feature. Specifically, each goal contains a database setup ( e.g. , statements to create the tables) and distinct variants of target queries that witness replay should match. For the row value IN feature, variants can vary the aggregate from MIN to MAX and change the columns in the row value. These target statements should satisfy the constraints of the generator under evolution. For example, nondeterministic features integrated into a TLP predicate may lead to false alarms; thus, the analyst should avoid incorporating such features. We discuss this in more detail in Section 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 能力目标描述了通过包含该功能的具体目标语句的不同变体来添加的 SQL 功能。 具体来说，每个目标都包含一个数据库设置（例如，创建表的语句）以及不同的目标查询变体，这些变体应能验证重播是否匹配。 对于行值 IN 功能，变体可以将聚合函数从 MIN 更改为 MAX，并修改行值中的列。 这些目标语句应满足生成器在演化过程中的约束条件。 例如，集成到 TLP 谓词中的非确定性特征可能导致误报；因此，分析人员应避免引入此类特征。 我们将在第 6 节中更详细地讨论这一点。

paragraphs.en: The constraints guide target synthesis before the coding agent modifies the generator. We provide the analyst agent with a natural language description of the supported target forms and the existing test oracle’s requirements. Listing 4 pairs a simplified TLP oracle with the corresponding instructions. First, a target should fit the oracle’s supported query form. For the WHERE variant of TLP, the analyst supplies a base query and a Boolean predicate from which the oracle constructs the partitions; an arbitrary SQL statement need not fit this form. New features can appear in the predicate or the shared FROM / JOIN structure. Second, the target should execute successfully on the selected DBMS with the supplied schema and data, so that the coding agent receives a valid example of the requested feature. Third, the analyst should avoid features that can invalidate the target oracle. This is a best-effort constraint—before adopting a target as a goal, the system independently executes its test case and checks that the base result equals the combined partition results.

paragraphs.en: The coding agent modifies SQLancer++ and constructs witnesses for the targets of one goal, as illustrated in Section 3 . Each modification attempt starts from the last accepted generator and runs in an isolated environment. The witness mechanism validates the modification by replaying the provided witnesses and checking them against the targets specified by the goal. Any mismatch or exception is used as feedback to help the coding agent modify the generator and witnesses. The current implementation runs replay through the existing oracle execution path and also requires a passing oracle outcome, in addition to the target comparison.

paragraphs.en: Separating the analyst agent from the coding agent allows goal preparation to proceed alongside implementation. paragraphs.en: Frequent bug-inducing test cases can saturate testing without exposing further bugs, which is a common issue in automated testing ( Chen et al., 2013 ; Donaldson et al., 2021 ) . A single SQL feature may repeatedly trigger known bugs, consuming testing time that could otherwise explore other features. After each fuzzing segment, a triage agent analyzes the reported bugs and identifies whether changes to the generator are needed. Large numbers of bug-inducing test cases increase triage effort; a repair agent thus modifies the generator to avoid recurring triggers.
paragraphs.zh: 频繁引发错误的测试用例可能会使测试过程饱和，却无法暴露更多错误，这是自动化测试中的一个常见问题（Chen 等人，2013；Donaldson 等人，2021）。 单个 SQL 功能可能反复触发已知错误，消耗本可用于探索其他功能的测试时间。 每次模糊测试阶段结束后，一个分类智能体都会分析报告的错误，并判断是否需要修改生成器。 大量引发错误的测试用例会增加分类工作量；因此，修复智能体会修改生成器，以避免重复触发这些错误。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 illustrates how repair fits into the pipeline. When bug-inducing test cases exceed a certain threshold ( e.g. , five for a testing segment), the orchestrator switches testing to a previously tested generator that did not show this behavior. The coding agent continues its current modification, but the completed result waits for repair before integration. Meanwhile, the repair agent modifies the generator that triggers the bugs, for example, by temporarily disabling the generation of certain SQL features that trigger known bugs. The orchestrator then mechanically merges the repair with the coding agent’s changes. Any conflicts are resolved by the coding agent. The combined generator is rebuilt and passes regression checks before entering another fuzzing segment. Testing continues with the earlier generator until the combined generator is ready; if no suitable earlier generator is available, it waits throughout repair. Section 5.4 examines how these activities overlap in a complete run.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 说明了修复如何融入整个流程。 当引发错误的测试用例超过某个阈值（例如，对于某个测试阶段为五个）时，协调器会将测试切换到之前已测试过且未表现出此行为的生成器。 编码智能体继续其当前的修改，但完成后的结果在集成前会等待修复。 与此同时，修复智能体会修改引发错误的生成器，例如通过暂时禁用某些已知会引发错误的 SQL 功能的生成。 随后，协调器会自动将修复与编码智能体的更改合并。 任何冲突都由编码智能体解决。 合并后的生成器会被重新构建，并在进入下一个模糊测试阶段前通过回归检查。 在合并后的生成器准备就绪之前，测试将继续使用之前的生成器；如果没有可用的合适旧生成器，则在整个修复过程中都会等待。 第 5.4 节将研究这些活动在完整运行中如何相互重叠。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated Gungnir in terms of bug-finding effectiveness, feature acquisition, performance compared with baselines, and practicality. First, we evaluate the bug-finding effectiveness of Gungnir on three popular DBMSs. Second, we measure whether witness replay helps coding agents acquire and preserve requested features. Third, we compare the evolved generator with state-of-the-art DBMS testing tools. Finally, we study how Gungnir evolves SQLancer++ and tests DBMSs from a bug-finding request.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从缺陷发现效果、功能获取、与基线方法的性能对比以及实用性等方面对 Gungnir 进行了评估。 首先，我们在三种流行的 DBMS 上评估了 Gungnir 的缺陷发现效果。 其次，我们衡量了见证重放是否有助于编码智能体获取并保留所需功能。 第三，我们将演化生成的生成器与当前最先进的 DBMS 测试工具进行了比较。 最后，我们研究了 Gungnir 如何从缺陷发现请求出发演化 SQLancer++ 并对 DBMS 进行测试。

paragraphs.en: We compare Gungnir with ShQveL, SQLancer, and the initial SQLancer++ generator. We also include the DBMSs’ native regression tests as a reference. ShQveL is the closest baseline because it also uses LLMs to extend test case generation, but learns SQL fragments rather than modifying generator code ( Zhong and Rigger, 2026a ) . SQLancer provides manually implemented generators and a platform for test oracles such as TLP, DQP, and CODDTest ( Rigger and Su, 2020b ; Ba and Rigger, 2024 ; Zhang and Rigger, 2025 ) . SQLancer++ provides a general generator across SQL dialects and underlies ShQveL and JIR ( Zhong and Rigger, 2026b ; Zhong and Rigger, 2026a ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) and serves as the initial generator. Test suites can supply seeds for mutation-based tools and already exceed SQL generators in coverage ( Zhong and Rigger, 2026b ; Zhong and Rigger, 2026a ) .

paragraphs.en: We conducted the experiments using a server with a 64-core AMD EPYC 7763 CPU at 2.45 GHz and 512 GB of memory running Ubuntu 22.04. For feature acquisition, each measurement used 4 generator threads, a CPU quota of 4 cores, and a 12 GiB memory limit for 600 seconds per seed. For baseline comparison, each tool received 24 hours, a CPU quota of 4 cores, and 24 GiB of memory during DBMS testing. Each generator used 1 thread; coverage replay for SQLite and DuckDB used 2 workers within the same allocation. The practicality case study used 6–8 fuzzer threads and a 24-hour budget for admitting new work.

paragraphs.en: We select three open-source DBMSs with different workload focuses. SQLite and PostgreSQL primarily target transactional workloads, while DuckDB primarily targets analytical workloads. SQLite and DuckDB run as embedded systems, whereas PostgreSQL runs as a server. We use SQLite, DuckDB, and PostgreSQL for bug finding and baseline comparison. For the coverage comparison, we selected SQLite 3.53.4, DuckDB 1.5.5, and PostgreSQL 18.6. SQLite and PostgreSQL are among the most challenging targets for finding logic bugs. SQLite’s TH3 test suite achieves 100% branch coverage of its core library. 1 1 1 https://www.sqlite.org/testing.html#test_coverage TLP implemented in SQLancer found no logic bugs in PostgreSQL ( Rigger and Su, 2020b ) . Among the DBMS testing papers on logic bug detection published within the last five years at SIGMOD and VLDB, only four report confirmed logic bugs in SQLite ( Zhang and Rigger, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Song et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) and four in PostgreSQL ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2025 ; Mang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . We excluded MySQL because earlier testing campaigns reported that many known bugs remained unfixed ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) , making it difficult to assess the contribution of new testing methods. We use DuckDB as a case study to evaluate the practicality of Gungnir .
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了三种工作负载侧重点不同的开源数据库管理系统（DBMS）。 SQLite 和 PostgreSQL 主要面向事务性工作负载，而 DuckDB 则主要面向分析性工作负载。 SQLite 和 DuckDB 以嵌入式系统形式运行，而 PostgreSQL 则以服务器形式运行。 我们使用 SQLite、DuckDB 和 PostgreSQL 进行缺陷查找和基准比较。 在覆盖度比较中，我们选择了 SQLite 3.53.4、DuckDB 1.5.5 和 PostgreSQL 18.6。 SQLite 和 PostgreSQL 是发现逻辑缺陷最具挑战性的目标之一。 SQLite 的 TH3 测试套件实现了其核心库 100% 的分支覆盖。1 1 1 https://www.sqlite.org/testing.html#test_coverage TLP 在 SQLancer 中实现的测试未能在 PostgreSQL 中发现任何逻辑缺陷（Rigger 和 Su，2020b）。 在过去五年内发表于 SIGMOD 和 VLDB 的关于逻辑缺陷检测的 DBMS 测试论文中，仅有四篇报告了在 SQLite 中发现的已确认的逻辑缺陷（Zhang 和 Rigger，2025；Zhang 等，2026b；Song 等，2024；Xiang 等，2026），以及四篇报告了在 PostgreSQL 中发现的逻辑缺陷（Deng 等，2025；Lai 等，2025；Mang 等，2026b；Zhang 等，2026b）。 我们排除了 MySQL，因为早期的测试项目报告称许多已知缺陷仍未修复（Zhong 等，2026），这使得评估新测试方法的贡献变得困难。 我们将 DuckDB 用作案例研究，以评估 Gungnir 的实用性。

sents.en: We select three open-source DBMSs with different workload focuses.
sents.zh: 我们选择了三种工作负载侧重点不同的开源数据库管理系统（DBMS）。

sents.en: SQLite and PostgreSQL primarily target transactional workloads, while DuckDB primarily targets analytical workloads.
sents.zh: SQLite 和 PostgreSQL 主要面向事务性工作负载，而 DuckDB 则主要面向分析性工作负载。

sents.en: SQLite and DuckDB run as embedded systems, whereas PostgreSQL runs as a server.
sents.zh: SQLite 和 DuckDB 以嵌入式系统形式运行，而 PostgreSQL 则以服务器形式运行。

sents.en: We use SQLite, DuckDB, and PostgreSQL for bug finding and baseline comparison.
sents.zh: 我们使用 SQLite、DuckDB 和 PostgreSQL 进行缺陷查找和基准比较。

sents.en: For the coverage comparison, we selected SQLite 3.53.4, DuckDB 1.5.5, and PostgreSQL 18.6.
sents.zh: 在覆盖度比较中，我们选择了 SQLite 3.53.4、DuckDB 1.5.5 和 PostgreSQL 18.6。

sents.en: SQLite and PostgreSQL are among the most challenging targets for finding logic bugs.
sents.zh: SQLite 和 PostgreSQL 是发现逻辑缺陷最具挑战性的目标之一。

sents.en: SQLite’s TH3 test suite achieves 100% branch coverage of its core library. 1 1 1 https://www.sqlite.org/testing.html#test_coverage TLP implemented in SQLancer found no logic bugs in PostgreSQL ( Rigger and Su, 2020b ) .
sents.zh: SQLite 的 TH3 测试套件实现了其核心库 100% 的分支覆盖。1 1 1 https://www.sqlite.org/testing.html#test_coverage TLP 在 SQLancer 中实现的测试未能在 PostgreSQL 中发现任何逻辑缺陷（Rigger 和 Su，2020b）。

sents.en: Among the DBMS testing papers on logic bug detection published within the last five years at SIGMOD and VLDB, only four report confirmed logic bugs in SQLite ( Zhang and Rigger, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Song et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) and four in PostgreSQL ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2025 ; Mang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 在过去五年内发表于 SIGMOD 和 VLDB 的关于逻辑缺陷检测的 DBMS 测试论文中，仅有四篇报告了在 SQLite 中发现的已确认的逻辑缺陷（Zhang 和 Rigger，2025；Zhang 等，2026b；Song 等，2024；Xiang 等，2026），以及四篇报告了在 PostgreSQL 中发现的逻辑缺陷（Deng 等，2025；Lai 等，2025；Mang 等，2026b；Zhang 等，2026b）。

sents.en: We excluded MySQL because earlier testing campaigns reported that many known bugs remained unfixed ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) , making it difficult to assess the contribution of new testing methods.
sents.zh: 我们排除了 MySQL，因为早期的测试项目报告称许多已知缺陷仍未修复（Zhong 等，2026），这使得评估新测试方法的贡献变得困难。

sents.en: We use DuckDB as a case study to evaluate the practicality of Gungnir .
sents.zh: 我们将 DuckDB 用作案例研究，以评估 Gungnir 的实用性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated Gungnir in an unstructured testing campaign on SQLite, DuckDB, and PostgreSQL, following the practice of prior DBMS testing work ( Rigger and Su, 2020b ; Zhong and Rigger, 2026b ) . We used TLP to detect incorrect query results and monitored failures such as crashes and internal errors. The system reduced and prioritized the bug-inducing test cases, which we further examined before reporting them to developers. We checked earlier issue reports and fixes for duplicates and excluded reports that developers classified as intended behavior from the bug count. The results include bugs found after generator modifications, through configuration changes, and through direct analysis of DBMS source code by an agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循以往数据库管理系统测试工作的实践（Rigger 和 Su，2020b；Zhong 和 Rigger，2026b），在 SQLite、DuckDB 和 PostgreSQL 上开展了一项非结构化测试活动，以评估 Gungnir。 我们使用 TLP 检测错误的查询结果，并监控崩溃和内部错误等故障。 该系统减少并优先处理了引发错误的测试用例，我们在向开发人员报告前进一步检查了这些用例。 我们查阅了早期的问题报告和修复内容以排除重复项，并将开发人员归类为预期行为的问题报告从错误数量中排除。 结果包括在生成器修改后、通过配置更改以及由智能体直接分析数据库管理系统源代码所发现的错误。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes the bug statistics for each DBMS. In total, we submitted 45 reports, of which 44 describe bugs confirmed by developers and 1 describes intended behavior. Among the confirmed bugs, 34 have been fixed. 32 bugs cause incorrect query results, while 12 cause unexpected errors or crashes. All 18 confirmed SQLite bugs have been fixed. The DuckDB developers confirmed 22 bugs and fixed 14; the PostgreSQL developers confirmed 4 and fixed 2. The five DuckDB reports from the practicality case study concern nested types, casts, statistics propagation, and predicate optimization; they are included in the confirmed bug counts. These results demonstrate that Gungnir can find bugs that DBMS developers consider worth fixing, including 17 logic bugs in SQLite and 3 in PostgreSQL despite extensive prior testing. For example, CODDTest reported six confirmed SQLite logic bugs ( Zhang and Rigger, 2025 ) , while EDC, SRS, Argus, and EPSC reported one, two, one, and one confirmed PostgreSQL logic bugs, respectively ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2025 ; Mang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . These findings show that extending the generator can expose new bugs in well-tested DBMSs even when using a single existing test oracle.

paragraphs.en: We further characterize how acquired features combine in these bug-inducing test cases. For each evolution run in our bug-finding campaign, the first bug appeared at evolution iteration 23.7 on average. The seed generator could find three DuckDB bugs without modifications. paragraphs.en: Listing 7 shows a PostgreSQL wrong result: the IN predicate matches only 'a' in the projection, but the filtered query counts two rows. The left column’s nondeterministic ICU collation equates 'a' and 'A' , while the right column uses the default collation. The planner deduplicated the semijoin’s right side under the default rather than the join collation, retaining both values and emitting the match twice; the fix uses the join collation. The initial generator could not create such collations. The coding agent added collation creation and assignment to text columns, allowing existing IN -subquery generation to expose the defect.
paragraphs.zh: 列表 7 显示了一个 PostgreSQL 的错误结果：IN 谓词在投影中仅匹配 'a'，但过滤查询却计入了两行。 左列的非确定性 ICU 排序将 'a' 和 'A' 视为相等，而右列则使用默认排序。 规划器在默认排序而非连接排序下对半连接的右侧进行了去重，保留了两个值并两次输出了匹配结果；修复方案使用了连接排序。 初始生成器无法创建此类排序。 编码智能体为文本列添加了排序创建和分配功能，使得现有的 IN 子查询生成能够暴露该缺陷。

sents.zh: 列表 7 显示了一个 PostgreSQL 的错误结果：IN 谓词在投影中仅匹配 'a'，但过滤查询却计入了两行。

sents.en: The left column’s nondeterministic ICU collation equates 'a' and 'A' , while the right column uses the default collation.
sents.zh: 左列的非确定性 ICU 排序将 'a' 和 'A' 视为相等，而右列则使用默认排序。

sents.en: The planner deduplicated the semijoin’s right side under the default rather than the join collation, retaining both values and emitting the match twice; the fix uses the join collation.
sents.zh: 规划器在默认排序而非连接排序下对半连接的右侧进行了去重，保留了两个值并两次输出了匹配结果；修复方案使用了连接排序。

sents.en: The initial generator could not create such collations.
sents.zh: 初始生成器无法创建此类排序。

sents.en: The coding agent added collation creation and assignment to text columns, allowing existing IN -subquery generation to expose the defect.
sents.zh: 编码智能体为文本列添加了排序创建和分配功能，使得现有的 IN 子查询生成能够暴露该缺陷。

paragraphs.en: These three cases illustrate why reaching new bugs requires extending query and schema generation beyond learning SQL fragments or discovering test oracles. First, the SQLite case requires a JSON table-valued function in the FROM clause and its output columns in subsequent predicates; ShQveL’s expression sketches cannot supply this integration, and Argus does not support SQLite ( Zhong and Rigger, 2026a ; Mang et al., 2026b ) . Second, the DuckDB case combines TABLESAMPLE , an index, and an IN subquery, which is beyond ShQveL’s expression sketches. Third, the PostgreSQL case requires creating a nondeterministic ICU collation and assigning it to a column before generating the IN predicate; learning expressions alone does not add this schema support. In principle, Argus’s table placeholders can represent the required table expressions with suitable snippets and could expose the latter two bugs; however, this requires generating corresponding snippet pools. Reaching features such as custom collations still requires an efficient schema generator. Gungnir instead integrates LLM knowledge into reusable query and schema generation rules, allowing subsequent random testing to combine the acquired features across newly generated database states without further LLM calls for SQL generation.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个案例说明了为何要发现新漏洞，需要将查询和模式生成扩展到学习 SQL 片段或发现测试预言机之外。 首先，SQLite 案例要求在 FROM 子句中使用一个 JSON 表值函数，并在后续谓词中使用其输出列；ShQveL 的表达式草图无法提供这种集成，而 Argus 不支持 SQLite（Zhong and Rigger, 2026a；Mang et al., 2026b）。 其次，DuckDB 案例结合了 TABLESAMPLE、一个索引和一个 IN 子查询，这超出了 ShQveL 表达式草图的能力范围。 第三，PostgreSQL 案例要求创建一个非确定性的 ICU 排序规则，并在生成 IN 谓词之前将其分配给一个列；仅学习表达式无法提供这种模式支持。 原则上，Argus 的表占位符可以通过合适的片段来表示所需的表表达式，并可能暴露后两种漏洞；然而，这需要生成相应的片段池。 要实现自定义排序规则等功能，仍然需要一个高效的模式生成器。 相比之下，Gungnir 将 LLM 知识整合到可重用的查询和模式生成规则中，使得后续的随机测试能够在新生成的数据库状态中结合已获取的功能，而无需再次调用 LLM 生成 SQL。

paragraphs.en: We selected 50 query targets from distinct extension goals mined from DuckDB’s documentation and regression tests after inspecting the generator’s source code for missing features. Each task supplied a target query, a schema, and data, which we checked against DuckDB. The targets cover eight categories, including expressions, aggregation, nested values, table sources, subqueries, and windows (see Figure 4 ). They require changes to generation rules, type handling, and scope handling. Listing 8 shows a condensed prompt for list subscripting. The initial generator supported function-based list access but lacked postfix subscripts. We instructed the agent to integrate typed subscripts into random generation over live schemas. Both conditions received the same target and schema settings, together with instructions to vary columns and constants, preserve earlier capabilities, and sample comparable generation choices uniformly.

paragraphs.en: We used OpenCode with deepseek-flash for all settings, starting from the same generator functionality and using development guidance derived from the same skill. We evaluated with and without witness under multi-session and one-session. These settings let us compare witness feedback during incremental feature acquisition across conversations and development of all requested features in one conversation. In multi-session evolution, the agent received one task per new conversation and started from the last accepted generator, with acceptance feedback and handoff notes. Each task allowed one coding attempt; a rejected modification left the accepted generator unchanged. In one-session evolution, the agent received all 50 tasks in one conversation and managed development and testing, including witness validation in the with-witness condition.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在所有设置中都使用了 OpenCode 和 deepseek-flash，从相同的生成器功能开始，并采用源自相同技能的开发指导。 我们在多会话和单会话模式下，分别在有和无见证者的情况下进行了评估。 这些设置使我们能够比较跨对话在增量获取功能过程中的见证者反馈，以及在一场对话中开发所有所需功能的进展。 在多会话演化中，智能体每次新对话都会收到一个任务，并从最后一个被接受的生成器开始，同时获得接受反馈和交接说明。 每个任务仅允许一次编码尝试；若修改被拒绝，则已接受的生成器保持不变。 在单会话演化中，智能体在一场对话中收到了全部 50 个任务，并负责开发、测试以及在有见证者条件下的见证者验证。

paragraphs.en: We measured task completion over time and query variety in the final generator. A task is complete when the generator reproduces its target query through the specified testing interface that the agent is required to implement. This query matching ignored whitespace, unquoted word case, and a terminal semicolon. We evaluated both session settings against all 50 target queries. At each multi-session checkpoint, task completion is the fraction of all targets reproduced by the current generator, including targets introduced in earlier tasks. For one-session evolution, we applied this metric to the final generator after the agent exited. This metric captures both newly acquired features and their preservation through subsequent changes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测量了最终生成器随时间推移的任务完成度和查询多样性。 当生成器通过智能体必须实现的指定测试接口重现其目标查询时，任务即告完成。 这种查询匹配忽略了空白符、未加引号的单词大小写以及结尾的分号。 我们对所有 50 个目标查询评估了两种会话设置。 在每个多会话检查点，任务完成度是指当前生成器重现的所有目标中占有的比例，包括早期任务中引入的目标。 对于单会话演化，我们在智能体退出后，将该指标应用于最终生成器。 该指标既捕捉了新获得的特征，也捕捉了这些特征在后续变化中的保留情况。

paragraphs.en: We also measured query variety through the distinct AST edges in random queries containing at least one target feature. We examined each query’s complete AST, including nested subqueries, and deduplicated edges by their signatures. Each signature consists of the parent node label, child role, and child node label; it preserves operator and function identities but ignores identifiers and literal values. We sampled 10,000 queries in total from each final generator across 3 fixed random seeds. For each seed, we divided the number of distinct edge signatures in queries containing a target feature by the number of all generated, parseable statements, then averaged these ratios across seeds.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 shows that witnesses improved task completion and query variety in multi-session evolution. The final generator reproduced 47 of 50 targets (94%) with witnesses, compared with 37 (74%) without witnesses. Witnesses helped complete targets involving ordered-set aggregation, recursive CTEs, and window exclusion frames. Query variety reached 0.382 distinct AST edges per SELECT with witnesses, compared with 0.038 without witnesses. In one-session evolution, the with-witness agent reproduced all 50 targets (100%), but query variety was only 0.004. We inspected the source code and found that it hardcoded the target queries for witness replay, yielding little variety involving the requested features during random generation. Without witnesses, the agent reproduced two targets (4%), while query variety reached 0.155. Without witnesses, multi-session evolution achieved less query variety than one-session evolution because it also include hardcode SELECT s for some tasks ( e.g. , list_aggregate ), while one-session evolution integrated features into recursive expressions and FROM components, enabling more varied combinations.

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows how multi-session evolution acquired and retained generator capabilities. paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports line and branch coverage. On SQLite, DuckDB, and PostgreSQL, Gungnir achieved 58.60%, 26.66%, and 29.91% branch coverage, respectively. ShQveL covered 31.20%, 26.38%, and 19.96% on the same systems. Compared with the initial SQLancer++ generator, Gungnir increased branch coverage by 31.17, 8.68, and 13.42 percentage points, respectively. It also covered more lines and branches than the measured generator baselines on all three DBMSs. The test suites achieved 40.83% and 50.61% branch coverage on DuckDB and PostgreSQL, respectively, exceeding all evaluated generators, including Gungnir . The gap is expected because evaluated generators focus on logic bug detection, and the query forms are constrained by the test oracle, while the test suites cover a broader range of operations, including schema changes and administrative commands. Gungnir achieved higher coverage on SQLite than on DuckDB and PostgreSQL; one possible explanation is that SQLite’s smaller codebase makes it easier for the analyst to identify SQL features from source code. A smaller set of SQL features could also make broader coverage easier to achieve.

paragraphs.en: We further evaluated the practicality of Gungnir through a case study on DuckDB. We recorded how the system evolved the generator, tested the DBMS, and generated bug reports. We used DuckDB nightly version with deepseek-flash through OpenCode and issued the following request to the orchestrator agent: “Do not stop until you find 20 unique, previously unknown bugs.” We counted the bug reports generated by final triage and measured elapsed time, recorded token use, and LLM cost through the end of that session.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一项针对 DuckDB 的案例研究，进一步评估了 Gungnir 的实用性。 我们记录了该系统如何演化生成器、测试 DBMS 以及生成错误报告的过程。 我们通过 OpenCode 使用 DuckDB 的夜间版本和 deepseek-flash，并向协调智能体发出以下请求：“在找到 20 个独特且此前未知的错误之前不要停止。”我们统计了最终筛选后生成的错误报告数量，并测量了从该会话开始到结束所花费的时间、使用的 token 数量以及 LLM 成本。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows how generator evolution and DBMS testing overlapped in the DuckDB run. The analyst agent examined DBMS source code and coverage results to identify additional SQL features, while the coding agent implemented the resulting goals. The controller agent selected goals and adjusted testing as new evidence became available, and the triage agent examined failures alongside continued testing. By the end of the run, the generator satisfied 81 SQL feature goals. The run accepted 92 source commits, including repeated work after rejection; each passed the existing regression checks, including witness replay. Over 23.99 hours, the fuzzer tested the seed and 82 evolved bundles in 90 segments, executing 29.49 million SQL statements. The fuzzer was active for 23.92 hours within this run, while coding sessions occupied 17.39 hours. These overlapping activities illustrate the pipeline in Section 4.3 : testing an accepted generator need not wait for the coding session to finish.

paragraphs.en: The DuckDB run reproduced nine kinds of bugs, from which the triage agent excluded four upstream duplicates and generated five bug reports. paragraphs.en: Witness replay checks whether the generator can reproduce specific target statements. However, it has three limitations. First, it does not guarantee how frequently the feature is generated during random testing. For example, a generator may be able to produce a target statement but need choices that are rarely selected during random generation. Second, it does not guarantee that the new feature can be combined correctly with other features. For example, a generator may be able to generate a new function requiring an argument of a specific data type, but such constraints may not be encoded in the generator’s random generation logic. Third, it requires that the target statement is valid and satisfies the test oracle’s input requirements; witness replay cannot check whether the target statement is semantically correct.
paragraphs.zh: 见证重播检查生成器是否能够重现特定的目标语句。 然而，这种方法存在三个局限性。 首先，它无法保证在随机测试中该特征被生成的频率。 例如，一个生成器可能能够产生目标语句，但需要依赖在随机生成过程中极少被选择的选项。 其次，它无法保证新特征能够与其他特征正确结合。 例如，一个生成器可能能够生成一个需要特定数据类型参数的新函数，但这些约束条件可能并未编码在生成器的随机生成逻辑中。 第三，它要求目标语句是有效的，并且满足测试预言机的输入要求；见证重播无法检查目标语句是否在语义上正确。

paragraphs.en: Automated DBMS testing combines test case generation with test oracles that detect unexpected behavior. For test case generation, Squirrel ( Zhong et al., 2020 ) and SQLRight ( Liang et al., 2022 ) mutate existing SQL statements and use validity and coverage feedback to guide testing. QPG ( Ba and Rigger, 2023 ) mutates the database state to obtain query plans that have not been seen during testing. SQLancer++ ( Zhong and Rigger, 2026b ) uses a shared adaptive generator to generate SQL statements across dialects. For test oracles, PQS ( Rigger and Su, 2020c ) checks query results against known rows. TLP ( Rigger and Su, 2020b ) generates three queries that partition the rows of an original query and checks whether their combined results match its result. NoREC ( Rigger and Su, 2020a ) compares the result of a query that can be optimized with that of an equivalent query designed to avoid those optimizations. DQP ( Ba and Rigger, 2024 ) executes a query using different query plans and compares their results. Radar ( Song et al., 2024 ) removes database metadata to check for incorrect query optimizations. JIR ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) uses the results of related join types to derive the expected result of a join. LLMs have been used to improve DBMS testing. ShQveL ( Zhong and Rigger, 2026a ) adds validated SQL fragments to a generator that reuses them during testing. QTRAN ( Lin et al., 2025 ) uses LLMs to translate queries across SQL dialects and adapts mutations to preserve the relations required by metamorphic testing. Argus ( Mang et al., 2026b ) prompts an LLM to generate abstract query pairs and checks their equivalence with a SQL equivalence prover before using them as test oracles. Building on SQLancer++, Gungnir modifies the generator’s source code to support new SQL features and uses existing test oracles to validate the generated statements.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化的 DBMS 测试将测试用例生成与能够检测意外行为的测试预言机相结合。 在测试用例生成方面，Squirrel（Zhong 等人，2020）和 SQLRight（Liang 等人，2022）通过变异现有 SQL 语句，并利用有效性和覆盖反馈来指导测试。 QPG（Ba 和 Rigger，2023）通过变异数据库状态来获取在测试过程中从未见过的查询计划。 SQLancer++（Zhong 和 Rigger，2026b）使用一个共享的自适应生成器来跨不同 SQL 方言生成 SQL 语句。 对于测试预言机，PQS（Rigger 和 Su，2020c）通过将查询结果与已知行进行比对来进行验证。 TLP（Rigger 和 Su，2020b）生成三个能够划分原始查询行的查询，并检查它们的合并结果是否与原始查询的结果一致。 NoREC（Rigger 和 Su，2020a）将可被优化的查询结果与一个旨在避免这些优化操作的等效查询结果进行比较。 DQP（Ba 和 Rigger，2024）使用不同的查询计划执行同一查询，并比较它们的结果。 Radar（Song 等人，2024）通过移除数据库元数据来检测错误的查询优化。 JIR（Xiang 等人，2026）利用相关连接类型的结果来推导出某个连接的预期结果。 LLM 已被用于改进 DBMS 测试。 ShQveL（Zhong 和 Rigger，2026a）向生成器中添加经过验证的 SQL 片段，以便在测试过程中重复使用这些片段。 QTRAN（Lin 等人，2025）利用 LLM 在不同 SQL 方言之间转换查询，并对变异操作进行调整，以保留变形测试所需的关联关系。 Argus（Mang 等人，2026b）通过提示 LLM 生成抽象的查询对，并使用 SQL 等价性证明器检查这些查询对的等价性，之后才将其用作测试预言机。 在 SQLancer++ 的基础上，Gungnir 修改了生成器的源代码以支持新的 SQL 特性，并利用现有的测试预言机来验证生成的语句。

paragraphs.en: LLMs have been used to improve query rewriting, configuration tuning, and workload generation. LLM-R 2 ( Li et al., 2024 ) uses an LLM to select rewrite rules from existing SQL rewriting systems. QO-Verify ( Narasayya and Chaudhuri, 2026 ) uses a query optimizer to check the equivalence of LLM-generated rewrites. SQLFlex ( An et al., 2026 ) parses SQL by integrating grammar-based parsing with LLM capabilities. SQLStorm ( Schmidt et al., 2025 ) generates SQL workloads for benchmarking. SQLBarber ( Lao and Trummer, 2026 ) generates SQL workloads according to requirements supplied by the user. Recently, LLM agents have been used to coordinate database tuning and SQL generation. AgentTune ( Li et al., 2025a ) coordinates LLM agents that analyze workloads, select configuration parameters, and refine database configurations. SysInsight ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) combines static analysis with LLM reasoning to derive tuning rules from DBMS source code and refines these rules using performance feedback. SQL-Factory ( Li et al., 2025b ) coordinates agents to generate SQL patterns, expand them into queries, and evaluate query quality for use in downstream tasks. Gungnir uses coding agents to extend a DBMS test generator with new SQL features.

paragraphs.en: LLMs can evolve software by modifying source code using execution feedback. AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) uses LLMs to generate code changes and combines evolutionary search with automated evaluation to improve algorithms. SkyDiscover ( Liu et al., 2026 ) evolves programs using adaptive search strategies. FrontierCS ( Mang et al., 2026a ) is a benchmark that evaluates executable solutions to open-ended computer science problems. IC3-Evolve ( Miao et al., 2026 ) modifies hardware model-checking heuristics and checks safety proofs and counterexample traces independently to validate the changes. Such LLM-based software evolution has been applied to software testing tools. ELFuzz ( Chen et al., 2025 ) uses LLMs to modify generation-based fuzzers and coverage feedback to guide their evolution. Gentoo ( Vikram and Padhye, 2026 ) uses coding agents to implement and refine input generators, with optional predicate-level coverage feedback. GenEvo ( Wei et al., 2026 ) uses LLMs to solve constraints and adapt input generation logic to target program states. Gungnir uses fixed SQL targets to validate generator modifications. Witness replay directs the modified generator to generate these statements, and existing test oracles check their required behavior. Replaying historical witnesses checks that subsequent modifications preserve previously witnessed target generation.

paragraphs.en: Prior work controls the choices made by a test generator to guide the inputs it generates. Swarm testing ( Groce et al., 2012 ) enables different subsets of features across tests. Directed swarm testing ( Alipour et al., 2016 ) uses feedback to guide feature selection. Targeted property-based testing ( Löscher and Sagonas, 2017 ) uses a fitness function supplied by the user to search for test inputs. Zest ( Padhye et al., 2019 ) mutates the parameters supplied to a structured generator to guide testing. Loaded Dice ( Tjoa et al., 2025 ) adjusts the weights of generator choices to better match a specified distribution of generated values. Parsing Randomness ( Goldstein and Pierce, 2022 ) treats a generator as a parser whose input is a sequence of random choices. Reflective generators ( Goldstein et al., 2023 ) recover the choices that a generator could use to generate a given value. Other work uses specifications to verify and synthesize generators. Coverage types ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) describe values that a generator is guaranteed to generate. Cobb ( LaFontaine et al., 2025 ) uses these types to repair generators that cannot generate all the specified values. Clouseau ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) uses underapproximate trace specifications to synthesize effectful test generators. Gungnir uses semantic choices as an executable witness that the modified generator can generate a fixed SQL target.

paragraphs.en: Extending a DBMS test generator requires implementing new SQL features and using them in queries that its oracle can check. We have presented Gungnir , which uses coding agents to modify the generator and witness replay to check that it can generate target statements. Generation witnesses record the database setup and choices needed to generate a target statement. Replay checks these choices and reports failures to guide further source modifications. We implemented Gungnir on top of SQLancer++ so that the resulting generator can continue testing without model calls. We evaluate feature acquisition separately from the bug-finding effectiveness of the evolved generators.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展 DBMS 测试生成器需要实现新的 SQL 功能，并在其 oracle 能够验证的查询中使用这些功能。 我们提出了 Gungnir，它利用编码智能体修改生成器并执行重播验证，以确认其能否生成目标语句。 生成见证会记录生成目标语句所需的数据库配置和选择项。 重播会检查这些选择项，并报告失败情况，以指导进一步的源代码修改。 我们在 SQLancer++ 之上实现了 Gungnir，这样生成的测试器无需模型调用即可继续执行测试。 我们将功能获取与演化生成器的缺陷发现效果分开进行评估。
